prompt:
A wide, calm painted backdrop for a short vertical video. 9:16 portrait.

The scene: a quiet stone courtyard in first-century Galilee at late afternoon — warm flagstones underfoot, a low wall, a doorway in deep shadow to one side, soft hills beyond. Nobody is in it. EMPTY OF PEOPLE — two figures will be drawn over this later and anything you put in the middle will be covered.

- It is ONE continuous scene. Do not divide the canvas. No vertical bands, stripes, panels, columns, blocks of flat colour, borders or seams of any kind. Ground, horizon and sky run unbroken from edge to edge.
- The LOWER MIDDLE especially must be open, calm and uncluttered — plain ground for figures to stand on.
- The TOP THIRD must be simple and quiet — open sky or plain shadow — with nothing important in it.
- STYLE, and be emphatic about it: flat graphic vector-like shapes with CLEAN HARD EDGES and DEEP SATURATED colour, matching the reference images exactly. Warm ochres, terracotta and deep blue shadow. No texture, no photographic detail, no gradients except broad simple ones.
- No text, no watermark, no border, no frame.
